phases.name: Establish the truth
phases.outcome: A verified baseline and a point-by-point response to the original critique.
phases.exit: The actual build, source packs, original paper and critique are reconciled. Every proposed change is classified as already satisfied, required, deferred or unresolved.
phases.scope: Read-only application review; write review artifacts only. No product redesign or data remodelling.

phases.name: Certify the data meaning
phases.outcome: One clear contract for identity, periods, commercial levels and financial measures.
phases.exit: Approved metric definitions, a source-coverage map, reconciled totals and executable checks. Unknowns remain explicit.
phases.scope: Audit and test before modifying the application. Corrected tonnage v2 supersedes v1.

phases.name: Prove a dealer pilot
phases.outcome: An ITUK dealer review connected to IDS only where identity is validated.
phases.exit: A declared pilot population reconciles to source. Dealer/site mappings are approved, exclusions are visible, and selected state survives the dealer-to-IDS journey.
phases.scope: A controlled ITUK candidate pilot, not a claim of network-wide readiness.

phases.name: Make comparisons useful
phases.outcome: Preserved portfolio breadth, better Genuine/BVP comparisons and defensible commercial review.
phases.exit: Every comparison states applicability, unit, price basis, source coverage and period. No unsupported leakage or band service-cover claims.
phases.scope: P2 and P3 may run in parallel after G1 when files and contracts do not overlap.

phases.name: Make the experience exceptional
phases.outcome: A distinctive, fast interface with trustworthy interactions and clear evidence.
phases.exit: Named user journeys pass visual, accessibility, performance, security and numerical QA on the selected pilot.
phases.scope: Design exploration can start earlier; live-data integration waits for its data gates.

phases.name: Operate and expand safely
phases.outcome: A repeatable monthly review, controlled refresh and evidence-based expansion.
phases.exit: Refresh and rollback are proven, operational ownership is assigned, user acceptance is recorded, and the next distributor meets the same entry criteria.
phases.scope: PRISM integration is conditional on the source-code review; it is not presumed necessary.

tasks.title: Fingerprint the real baseline
tasks.work: Identify the actual entry point, stack, active branch or equivalent snapshot, dirty working tree, version labels and reproducible start commands. Do not reset or overwrite local work.
tasks.inputs: Repository at the user-supplied root.
tasks.output: BASELINE.md plus tracked-file or SHA-256 manifest.
tasks.acceptance: A second reviewer can identify exactly which build was inspected. Version 2.2 is confirmed, corrected or left explicitly unverified.

tasks.title: Return the original critique and paper
tasks.work: Read the exact critique path. Identify the paper it critiques from the file or repository; do not silently choose a different paper. Preserve both originals unchanged.
tasks.inputs: Original critique and its referenced strategy paper.
tasks.output: Original critique copy, exact paper identity, and CRITIQUE_INDEX.md with headings and source locations.
tasks.acceptance: Every criticism can be traced to the original text; a missing paper is reported, not guessed.

tasks.title: Inventory protected features and regressions
tasks.work: Record where the portfolio overview and Genuine/BVP comparisons live, how they work, and whether the sales cube is absent and photographs remain deferred. Capture existing journeys before change.
tasks.inputs: Running baseline and existing tests.
tasks.acceptance: Existing work is recorded as present, partial, absent or unverified; no working feature is put back into the backlog as a rebuild without justification.

tasks.title: Catalogue source packs and supersession
tasks.work: Locate corrected tonnage v2 and the ITUK dealer-data/source-code pack. Inventory schemas, periods, source levels and correction evidence. Quarantine v1 from active ingestion without deleting originals.
tasks.inputs: Pack manifests, read-me files, correction logs and source files.
tasks.acceptance: The selected pack version and hash are explicit. Previously corrected v2 issues are marked resolved unless a new reproducible regression exists.

tasks.title: Audit code reuse and PRISM boundaries
tasks.work: Read the available source code and PRISM overview. Identify useful existing components, transformations, routes, output contracts and coupling. Do not infer what PRISM does from its name.
tasks.inputs: Actual application code and any PRISM documentation.
tasks.output: REUSE_MAP.md with reuse, adapter, isolate or investigate recommendations.
tasks.acceptance: Every recommendation cites a file or function. No framework rewrite or duplicate calculation engine is proposed without evidence.

tasks.title: Reproduce the baseline run
tasks.work: Use documented local commands where available. Report test results, build errors, route failures and environment details. Do not install unknown dependencies or change configuration merely to manufacture a pass.
tasks.inputs: C01 baseline and approved local environment.
tasks.output: BASELINE_TEST_REPORT.md with commands, results and known limitations.
tasks.acceptance: A failed or unavailable check remains visible; screenshots and a successful build are not represented as numerical validation.

tasks.title: Package a compact evidence handoff
tasks.work: Assemble the baseline, critique, feature inventory, source manifests, reuse map and test report. Include only necessary safe samples; exclude credentials, caches and bulk unrelated data.
tasks.inputs: C01-C06 outputs.
tasks.output: A dated R0 review packet with MANIFEST.md and OPEN_QUESTIONS.md.
tasks.acceptance: The packet is sufficient for ChatGPT to review without pretending it has local repository access. Missing items are listed.

tasks.title: Set the orchestration charter and current-state register
tasks.work: Separate reported baseline, agreed decisions, verified evidence and proposals. Define the handoff loop and release authority.
tasks.inputs: Existing conversation decisions; later reconcile to C07.
tasks.output: Current-state register and orchestration charter in this roadmap.
tasks.acceptance: No repository inspection, critique review or Cursor dispatch is falsely claimed.

tasks.title: Adjudicate the original critique point by point
tasks.work: Read the original criticism alongside the exact paper and build evidence. Accept, partly accept, rebut with evidence, defer or flag each item as unverifiable.
tasks.inputs: C02 originals; C03-C06 supporting evidence.
tasks.output: CRITIQUE_RESPONSE.md with evidence, decision, affected ticket and acceptance test per item.
tasks.acceptance: No criticism is invented or answered from a second-hand paraphrase. The original wording remains traceable.

tasks.title: Publish the verified maturity assessment
tasks.work: Assess product journeys, data readiness, mapping readiness, test coverage and deployment evidence separately. Report unknowns rather than an invented completion percentage.
tasks.inputs: C07 review packet.
tasks.output: STATE_OF_UNIVERSE.md and a feature evidence register.
tasks.acceptance: Each status is tied to a build or artifact. Reported v2.2 and proposed milestones are not confused.

tasks.title: Reconcile the backlog and decide G0
tasks.work: Close tasks already satisfied by evidence, retain real gaps and convert accepted critique points into scoped work orders.
tasks.inputs: A02-A03 and all P0 evidence.
tasks.output: Approved next work order and G0 disposition.
tasks.acceptance: No repeated tonnage-v1 feedback, no automatic redesign, and no unreviewed product change enters the next packet.

tasks.title: Write dataset contracts
tasks.work: For each selected source, record grain, keys, measures, units, commercial level, reporting clock, coverage, freshness and provenance. Record whether a value is observed, derived or modelled.
tasks.inputs: Approved source inventory and real schema samples.
tasks.acceptance: Every source used by a pilot view has a contract; no field meaning is inferred only from a convenient column name.

tasks.title: Normalize identifiers without destroying identity
tasks.work: Preserve part numbers and customer/dealer/site IDs as strings. Keep original and normalized values, leading zeros and collision reports. Apply only approved equivalence rules.
tasks.inputs: C08 contracts and source identifier samples.
tasks.output: Identifier transforms and collision/alias exception report.
tasks.acceptance: Normalization is reversible or traceable; two unrelated entities are never merged because a name or country looks similar.

tasks.title: Reconcile transactions at each commercial level
tasks.work: Reconcile raw-to-loaded quantities and values separately for ISZE-to-distributor and distributor-to-dealer data. Test duplicates, returns, credits, unit conversions and exclusions.
tasks.inputs: Transaction sources and C08 contracts.
tasks.acceptance: Reported totals match the declared source scope within an agreed rounding tolerance. No cross-level double counting or join fan-out occurs.

tasks.title: Make periods and coverage explicit
tasks.work: Identify complete months, partial extracts, CY/FY calendars, time zones where relevant, and currency/FX policy. Retain source currency and original period before any derived presentation conversion.
tasks.inputs: Source contracts and refresh history.
tasks.acceptance: One clock and period per measure; L12 is anchored to twelve complete eligible months, not assumed to be the latest calendar year.

tasks.title: Implement measure-basis metadata
tasks.work: Carry quantity, valuation basis, transaction level, reporting period, currency, population and source alongside every metric. Keep reference-price valuation separate from actual billing and modelled demand.
tasks.inputs: A06 draft dictionary, approved after source review.
tasks.output: Metric metadata interface and rendering fixtures.
tasks.acceptance: An unpriced quantity never becomes euros; an indicative reference valuation never appears under an actual-revenue label.

tasks.title: Provide lineage and exception evidence
tasks.work: Connect each displayed aggregate to source version, scope, transformations and exclusions. Keep unmatched parts/dealers, missing prices and ambiguous applicability visible in an exception ledger.
tasks.inputs: C08-C12 outputs.
tasks.output: Evidence record and EXCEPTIONS.md or equivalent table.
tasks.acceptance: A reviewer can explain an aggregate without downloading confidential bulk data; excluded records remain countable and retrievable within permission.

tasks.title: Automate the non-negotiable data tests
tasks.work: Turn the approved business rules into tests, including null versus zero, duplicate joins, clocks, quantities versus euros, exclusive versus pooled applicability and repeated market actuals.
tasks.inputs: A05-A08 decisions and C08-C13 transforms.
tasks.output: DATA_INVARIANTS test suite and G1 evidence report.
tasks.acceptance: Deliberately broken fixtures fail the relevant tests; valid corrected tonnage-v2 fixtures pass.

tasks.title: Build the distributor source-coverage map
tasks.work: Declare which source levels, periods, dealer populations and measure bases are available per distributor. Decide which comparisons are eligible before any ranking.
tasks.inputs: C04, C08 and C11.
tasks.output: COVERAGE_MAP.md with eligible, restricted and unknown uses.
tasks.acceptance: Missing dealer data is recorded as unknown downstream activity, not zero. Warranty is not used to infer scheduled servicing.

tasks.title: Approve the metric and financial-basis dictionary
tasks.work: Define what each figure means, its formula, denominator and forbidden interpretations. Refine the draft in this roadmap against actual source contracts.
tasks.inputs: Draft dictionary plus C08-C11 evidence.
tasks.acceptance: Measured quantities, indicative valuation, actual billing and modelled expectation cannot be confused by wording or presentation.

tasks.title: Test ITUK pilot eligibility
tasks.work: Profile the real ITUK data for grain, scope, periods, customer identity, values and source completeness. Select only justified dealer/site populations and measures.
tasks.inputs: ITUK pack and C08-C11 reports.
tasks.output: ITUK_PILOT_ELIGIBILITY.md with exclusions and unresolved questions.
tasks.acceptance: A commercial-level pilot can proceed independently of IDS where dealer-to-IDS identity is not yet approved.

tasks.title: Review corrected tonnage v2 once, against evidence
tasks.work: Read the correction log and evidence before testing residual issues. Record closed corrections and test only remaining uncertainties or new regressions.
tasks.inputs: Corrected tonnage v2, C04 and C13 evidence.
tasks.acceptance: No apportionment of shared parts; exclusive numerator uses the declared filter; CY and FY are not added; repeated market actuals remain context, not band numerator.

tasks.title: Create the approved dealer/customer/site bridge
tasks.work: Implement a versioned identity bridge with source IDs, entity type, parent/child relationships, validity dates, approval provenance and mapping status. Support unmatched and multi-site customers explicitly.
tasks.inputs: A09 mapping policy and actual source identities.
tasks.acceptance: No country, submission cohort or fuzzy-name inference creates an approved relationship. Multi-site billing is not allocated to sites without evidence.

tasks.title: Ingest IDS as dated dealer assessments
tasks.work: Preserve assessment date, dealer/site identity, questionnaire version, section scores, response completeness and source. Do not overwrite previous assessments with only the latest value.
tasks.inputs: Actual IDS source and scoring definitions.
tasks.output: IDS assessment contract and validated snapshots.
tasks.acceptance: A score retains its date, scoring version and assessed population; dealer self-assessment is not renamed a distributor audit.

tasks.title: Expose ambiguous and excluded joins
tasks.work: Provide a mapping review table for approved, unresolved, rejected and out-of-scope joins. Measure one-to-many and many-to-many risks before enabling linked views.
tasks.inputs: C15-C16 joins.
tasks.acceptance: Unresolved records stay outside linked metrics while remaining visible; row fan-out cannot inflate quantities or values.

tasks.title: Build the dealer commercial review slice
tasks.work: Use the existing architecture to show dealer purchasing by eligible period, category, part and Genuine/BVP tier with source-basis labels and declared coverage. A commercial-only version can use an approved commercial customer/dealer identity without an IDS site link. Unsupported site detail remains unavailable.
tasks.inputs: Approved ITUK pilot slice and A10 review specification.
tasks.output: Dealer commercial view with source-reconciled fixtures.
tasks.acceptance: This is distributor-to-dealer purchasing where supported, not dealer-to-end-customer sales or inferred servicing. Commercial identity is validated for the declared population; IDS linking is not a prerequisite for this commercial-only scope.

tasks.title: Connect eligible IDS detail without scoring a distributor
tasks.work: Add the linked assessment summary and sections only for approved identities. Show assessment date, matched population and denominator for any aggregate.
tasks.inputs: C16-C18 and A11 comparison rules.
tasks.acceptance: A distributor node remains commercial. Any dealer-assessment summary names its exact population, date basis and scoring scope.

tasks.title: Preserve context across linked journeys
tasks.work: Retain distributor, dealer, sales period, taxonomy filters and financial basis across drill-through. Keep the assessment date independent from the sales clock.
tasks.inputs: A10 journey and existing route/state architecture.
tasks.output: Shareable route/state contract and journey tests.
tasks.acceptance: Opening IDS cannot silently change the sales period; unmatched mappings produce an explanation, not a fake zero.

tasks.title: Return a representative pilot evidence set
tasks.work: Test approved normal, unmatched, multi-site, missing-price, returns and partial-period cases. Reconcile visible totals before and after joins and filters. State whether the packet covers commercial-only or linked-IDS scope. A commercial-only packet cannot claim completion of C19/C20 or full G2.
tasks.inputs: C15-C20 and agreed sample selection.
tasks.acceptance: The sample includes edge cases rather than only clean success paths; the declared pilot population is reproducible.

tasks.title: Define and approve identity-mapping rules
tasks.work: Separate distributor, commercial customer, dealer entity and physical site. Define the evidence needed for an approved link and route business ownership questions to Jerome or the responsible distributor.
tasks.inputs: Draft policy here, source contracts and actual identity candidates.
tasks.acceptance: ChatGPT does not invent site responsibility or certify a fuzzy match. Multi-site commercial facts stay at their measured grain.

tasks.title: Specify the connected dealer review
tasks.work: Define a review that answers what was purchased, how the mix changed, what IDS actually says, what evidence is missing, and what follow-up is agreed.
tasks.inputs: A07 eligibility and existing dealer/IDS journeys.
tasks.output: DEALER_REVIEW_SPEC.md with fields, states and acceptance examples.
tasks.acceptance: Commercial and assessment evidence stay separate; the review gives a distributor useful monthly output rather than only requesting data.

tasks.title: Approve fair IDS comparisons
tasks.work: Define eligible scoring versions, section denominators, dated cohorts, missing-response treatment and whether entity/site aggregation is permissible. Do not imply causation from coincident scores and purchases.
tasks.inputs: IDS definitions and C16-C17 evidence.
tasks.acceptance: The displayed comparator is named and reproducible; inconsistent questionnaires or undefined populations are not pooled.

tasks.title: Review pilot findings and decide G2
tasks.work: Review numerical, identity and interaction evidence. Separate a usable commercial pilot from a still-blocked IDS connection and decide the scope actually supportable.
tasks.inputs: C21 and A09-A11.
tasks.acceptance: The decision states accepted scope, exclusions, unresolved mapping ownership and any rejected claims. A limited commercial-pilot decision leaves full G2 and unresolved IDS tasks open.

tasks.title: Protect and strengthen the portfolio overview
tasks.work: Keep the existing overview and its navigation. Improve filters, coverage states and links to evidence only where the audit identifies a gap; avoid substituting a dealer-only homepage.
tasks.inputs: C03 protected-feature baseline and approved metric contracts.
tasks.output: Portfolio improvements with before/after regression evidence.
tasks.acceptance: Existing supported portfolio journeys still work; no removed sales cube is reintroduced under a new name.

tasks.title: Build a documented Genuine/BVP relationship layer
tasks.work: Use validated relationship data, not name similarity alone. Record fitment/applicability, relationship type, units/pack, range validity, price availability and source.
tasks.inputs: A13 eligibility policy and actual parts reference data.
tasks.acceptance: Only evidence-supported comparisons are eligible; missing BVP coverage is not filled with speculative substitutes.

tasks.title: Implement like-for-like comparisons
tasks.work: Show eligible Genuine/BVP unit prices, quantities and mix with common unit, currency, date and transaction/reference basis. Explain non-comparable cases in place.
tasks.inputs: C23 plus approved financial metadata.
tasks.acceptance: Reference-price differences are labelled indicative, not realized savings or actual customer prices. Different pack sizes are not compared unadjusted.

tasks.title: Show purchasing patterns with coverage context
tasks.work: Describe regular, intermittent and absent recorded purchasing only within a declared complete scope. Support seasonality and returns visibility without inferring end-customer demand.
tasks.inputs: Eligible dealer/distributor transactions and coverage map.
tasks.output: Purchasing-pattern view with explicit unknown states.
tasks.acceptance: No recorded purchase is not labelled leakage automatically; stock, applicability, availability and source completeness remain review questions.

tasks.title: Integrate the three tonnage lenses safely
tasks.work: Expose recorded exclusive-applicability purchasing, modelled expected demand by band, and market actual purchasing as separate views. Reuse v2 corrections rather than recreating v1 transformations.
tasks.inputs: Approved v2 disposition and real corrected files.
tasks.acceptance: Use sums_to_n_series_total == yes where specified; single_band_only is the exclusive numerator; also_fits_band is non-additive; shared records remain pooled.

tasks.title: Separate observed change, modelled potential and unknowns
tasks.work: Display evidence class alongside each candidate review item. Keep measured change distinct from reference-valued or modelled potential and unassessed gaps.
tasks.inputs: A14 policy and approved metric metadata.
tasks.acceptance: No modelled band gap becomes measured leakage, service cover or a distributor-performance ranking.

tasks.title: Export a defensible distributor review
tasks.work: Export the selected scope, comparison tables, source basis, coverage exceptions and evidence references. Keep sales levels and dates in headings, not hidden footnotes only.
tasks.inputs: A16 storyboard and approved comparison views.
tasks.acceptance: An exported screenshot or table remains interpretable outside the app and contains only authorized population data.

tasks.title: Approve Genuine/BVP comparison eligibility
tasks.work: Define the minimum evidence for comparable range, fitment, pack unit, price basis, validity and availability. Distinguish documented alternatives from broader category comparisons.
tasks.inputs: Draft policy here and actual relationship sources.
tasks.output: COMPARISON_ELIGIBILITY.md with accepted and rejected examples.
tasks.acceptance: A valid category comparison never silently asserts technical interchangeability or realized financial benefit.

tasks.title: Design honest opportunity prioritization
tasks.work: Classify review candidates by evidence strength and actionability. Require source coverage before rankings and define which additional facts are needed before discussing a commercial intervention.
tasks.inputs: A05 coverage map and real purchasing/parts evidence.
tasks.acceptance: Warranty, absent files, missing recorded purchasing and reference-valued gaps are not treated as proof of leakage.

tasks.title: Challenge financial and service-demand conclusions
tasks.work: Trace representative displayed calculations to source. Test whether quantities, value bases, exclusive applicability and model assumptions support the stated conclusion.
tasks.inputs: C24-C27 fixtures and source lineage.
tasks.acceptance: Every accepted claim is limited to its measured or modelled basis; repeated market actuals cannot become a band-specific ratio.

tasks.title: Define the distributor monthly-review story
tasks.work: Specify the practical return to distributors: connected dealer review, eligible Genuine/BVP comparison, purchasing-pattern discussion and owned follow-ups.
tasks.inputs: A10, A14 and actual pilot capabilities.
tasks.acceptance: The story supports ISZE-to-distributor collaboration, not an invented direct-to-retail sales offer or complete-repair ordering workflow.

tasks.title: Unify navigation without a framework rewrite
tasks.work: Implement a coherent path from portfolio to distributor context, eligible dealer, part/category evidence and action. Reuse actual shared components and existing routing where possible.
tasks.inputs: C05 reuse map and A17-A18 UX specification.
tasks.output: Navigation change with route regression tests.
tasks.acceptance: A user can return to the portfolio without losing context; the implementation fits the audited stack rather than assuming a new one.

tasks.title: Apply a coherent visual system
tasks.work: Use restrained dark surfaces, clear typography, deliberate Isuzu-red emphasis and generous space as a proposed visual direction. Reconcile with existing approved design tokens before changing working screens.
tasks.inputs: Approved existing design assets and A17 brief.
tasks.acceptance: Numerical hierarchy is legible, status is not color-only, and decorative treatment never hides labels or changes semantic meaning.

tasks.title: Build signature views that reveal useful information
tasks.work: Prototype a stable portfolio composition view, a Genuine/BVP purchasing time trace and a linked dealer commercial/assessment view. Choose scales and encodings from the real measure contract.
tasks.inputs: A18 interaction specification and validated data slices.
tasks.output: Three evaluated view prototypes, retaining only those that improve the task.
tasks.acceptance: Area, position and color have labelled meanings; IDS is not combined into a synthetic sales-performance score; a table alternative exists.

tasks.title: Add progressive detail and evidence drawers
tasks.work: Keep overview screens focused while making definitions, scope, price basis, match status, exclusions and lineage available in one consistent evidence drawer.
tasks.inputs: C13 evidence record and A18 specification.
tasks.output: Reusable evidence panel and interaction tests.
tasks.acceptance: Critical basis labels remain visible without opening the drawer; the drawer adds detail rather than concealing caveats.

tasks.title: Design every non-happy-path state
tasks.work: Implement empty, unknown, filtered-out, stale, partial-period, denied-access, ambiguous-join and calculation-error states. Provide meaningful recovery and preserve user context.
tasks.inputs: Source contracts, access model and pilot edge cases.
tasks.output: State catalogue with executable view tests.
tasks.acceptance: Unknown data never renders as zero; errors do not expose secrets; stale evidence is not displayed as current without a label.

tasks.title: Benchmark performance and accessibility
tasks.work: Measure real dataset size, startup, filtering and drill-through on an agreed reference machine. Test keyboard access, focus order, contrast, reduced motion and table alternatives. Optimize only measured bottlenecks.
tasks.inputs: Baseline run, actual pilot build and A19 user tasks.
tasks.acceptance: Budgets are agreed from the baseline, not claimed in advance; any virtualization or worker is justified by measured need.

tasks.title: Test access control and complete product regression
tasks.work: Check distributor/dealer data isolation in the actual deployment model, including exports and underlying data delivery. Re-run protected-feature, semantic and journey tests.
tasks.inputs: Audited deployment architecture, C14 and completed pilot views.
tasks.acceptance: Client-side hiding alone is not claimed as authorization. A cross-distributor account cannot fetch or export unauthorized rows.

tasks.title: Set the design brief against the existing baseline
tasks.work: Translate the desired distinctive presentation into a practical hierarchy, layout, density and motion brief. Identify what must stay unchanged and what genuinely needs improvement.
tasks.inputs: C03 screenshots, current approved styling and pilot use cases.
tasks.acceptance: The brief is grounded in actual screens; no claim is made that an unseen presentation theme has been matched exactly.

tasks.title: Specify signature interactions and truth-preserving encodings
tasks.work: Define what each proposed graphic helps the user decide, its grain, axes or area, tooltip, drill-through and uncertainty states. Reject visuals that merely decorate missing evidence.
tasks.inputs: Draft interaction rules here plus validated metric contracts.
tasks.acceptance: No arbitrary 3D globe, force-layout relationship or merged score creates a false analytic relationship. Motion helps orientation and can be reduced.

tasks.title: Define task-based usability acceptance
tasks.work: Write user tests for portfolio exploration, a like-for-like BVP comparison, a dealer-to-IDS review, an unknown-state explanation and a review export.
tasks.inputs: A17-A18 and agreed ISZE/distributor tasks.
tasks.acceptance: Success means finding the right answer with its limitations, not merely clicking through a polished screen.

tasks.title: Review visual, numerical and interaction evidence
tasks.work: Inspect screenshots and returned run evidence against the brief and user tasks. Separate directly inspected appearance from interactions that still require local execution.
tasks.inputs: C35 packet, screenshots and A19 scenarios.
tasks.acceptance: No interaction is called tested solely from a screenshot, and no chart is accepted solely because it looks impressive.

tasks.title: Make refreshes reproducible and safe
tasks.work: Document ingest, validation and publishing steps. Preserve a last-known-good dataset, block failed new inputs and display dataset version and freshness.
tasks.inputs: Approved source contracts and real operational environment.
tasks.acceptance: A failed refresh cannot silently replace good data with partial or empty results; rollback is proven.

tasks.title: Create a minimal review-action workflow
tasks.work: Reuse a suitable existing action store if present. Capture owner, distributor/dealer scope, evidence reference, decision, due date and status with appropriate permissions.
tasks.inputs: A21 playbook and C05 reuse findings.
tasks.acceptance: Actions refer to an actual review and approved evidence. No autonomous external messages or commercial commitments are sent.

tasks.title: Produce shareable, access-safe review packets
tasks.work: Package the selected review with measure definitions, source versions, unresolved items and actions. Remove unauthorized populations and avoid embedding sensitive raw data unnecessarily.
tasks.inputs: C28 exports and C37 action model.
tasks.output: Reusable distributor review packet and access tests.
tasks.acceptance: A shared packet includes enough provenance to interpret its numbers and no hidden rows from another distributor.

tasks.title: Create release evidence and regression snapshots
tasks.work: Capture the build fingerprint, dataset versions, tested journeys, reconciliation results, known issues and approved exceptions for each candidate release.
tasks.inputs: Current code and data/test evidence.
tasks.acceptance: Source, data and review versions are traceable together; visual snapshots do not replace calculation tests.

tasks.title: Prepare deployment, rollback and change notes
tasks.work: Use the actual hosting and access model. Document migration scope, rollback point, protected features and known limitations. Do not deploy to shared users without explicit release authorization.
tasks.inputs: C39 release packet and A22 decision.
tasks.acceptance: The release can be rolled back and its acceptance scope is clear. Jerome or the named product owner authorizes rollout.

tasks.title: Implement a PRISM adapter only if approved
tasks.work: If the evidence-based decision calls for integration, reuse validated outputs through a narrow versioned contract. Otherwise record the deferral and leave the module independent.
tasks.inputs: C05 source-code review and A24 decision.
tasks.output: A small tested adapter, or documented no-integration decision.
tasks.acceptance: No duplicate business-calculation engine is introduced; PRISM remains undefined until its actual code and purpose are reviewed.

tasks.title: Template onboarding for the next distributor
tasks.work: Parameterize proven contracts, coverage reporting, identity mapping and access tests. Add a new market only through its own evidence and approvals.
tasks.inputs: Accepted pilot, A24 expansion decision and operational runbooks.
tasks.acceptance: Country or a previous distributor mapping never becomes a shortcut for validating the new population.

tasks.title: Define the operating review and ownership loop
tasks.work: Specify who supplies each dataset, who approves identity, who reviews exceptions and who owns actions. Define a repeatable review agenda without scheduling an unrequested automation.
tasks.inputs: A16 story and pilot feedback.
tasks.acceptance: Each unresolved issue has an owner and next decision; the system provides useful output to participating distributors.

tasks.title: Issue the release recommendation and G5 assessment
tasks.work: Review operational, numerical, access and user-acceptance evidence. Recommend accept, limited pilot, hold or reject with explicit reasons; leave commercial rollout authority with Jerome.
tasks.inputs: C39, A20, A21 and actual user feedback.
tasks.output: RELEASE_REVIEW.md with approved scope and remaining risks.
tasks.acceptance: No production readiness is claimed without execution and user evidence; an approved limited pilot is not called a network rollout.

tasks.title: Measure pilot value without inventing impact
tasks.work: Define baseline measures for correct task completion, review effort, traceability, unresolved mappings and action follow-through. Separate observed improvements from revenue hypotheses.
tasks.inputs: Draft scorecard here and actual before/after review observations.
tasks.acceptance: No estimated savings, sales uplift or leakage recovery is reported as realized value without the required observations.

tasks.title: Decide the next distributor and PRISM role
tasks.work: Compare next-market source readiness and business value. Choose reuse, integration, independence or deferral for PRISM from its inspected code, not its name. Recheck deferred scope before expansion.
tasks.inputs: A12, A22, A23 and C05 evidence.
tasks.output: NEXT_RELEASE_DECISION.md with entry criteria and conditional work order.
tasks.acceptance: Expansion follows verified data/access readiness. Photography and the removed sales cube do not return by default.

revision: R1 - consolidated strategy and first Cursor package
status_note: Planning states only. No Cursor task has been dispatched, executed or accepted by this document.

revision_changes.change: Separate commercial-only pilot eligibility from the IDS-linking prerequisites. Full G2 still requires approved identity links, fair assessment comparisons and linked-journey evidence.
Only R0 is selected in the first package. Later tasks remain planning work and are not implementation authorization.
Original paper, original critique, repository and corrected packs have not been inspected in this session. Missing originals keep critique review pending.
